home.hero_description: Tens of millions of pilgrims gather along the sacred Godavari. We ensure no child, elder, or pilgrim stays separated from their family.
home.step1_desc: Register your family in 2 minutes. Receive waterproof QR wristbands or printable ID cards for children and elderly relatives before entering the ghats.
home.step2_desc: If separated, family or any finder reports instantly. Works completely offline even when cellular towers are congested.
home.step3_desc: Help desks use secure client-side matching and a strict 4-step ID checklist to safely reunite pilgrims with their verified guardians.

family.title: Family Registration & Safety Wristbands
family.desc: Register your family members before stepping onto the ghats. Generate printable wristbands with QR codes and tamper-evident IDs.
family.medical_notes: Medical or Special Language Notes (e.g., speaks only Odia, diabetic)
family.photo_label: Clear Face Photo (Recommended for instant matching)
family.consent_title: Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act Consent
family.consent_body: In accordance with the DPDP Act 2023: Your family information and face descriptors are stored securely on this device and encrypted servers solely for reunification during Godavari Pushkaralu 2027. Children's data requires verifiable guardian consent. All records are permanently scheduled for purge 30 days after festival conclusion. Full phone numbers and addresses are strictly concealed from the public.
family.consent_agree: I am the lawful guardian. I give verifiable consent to store this data strictly for lost-person reunification during Pushkaralu.
family.returning_user: Already registered? Login with Phone OTP
family.otp_desc: Enter the 6-digit OTP sent to your registered phone number (Prototype test OTP: 123456).
family.print_limit_reached: Print limit (3) reached. Please visit any Ghat Help Desk for an official reprint.
family.card_emergency_note: Lost? Call Guardian or Emergency Helpline 112 / 1098
family.band_emergency_note: Lost? Scan QR code or call Pushkaralu Helpline: 112

band.title: Pilgrim Safety Wristband
band.instructions: Wrap around wrist or pin to child's/elder's kurta. Waterproof print.

found_report.title: Found a Lost Person (Volunteer & Finder)
found_report.safety_warning_body:
1. Stay with the lost person in a well-lit, public location.
2. Guide them directly to the nearest Help Desk or Police booth.
3. Never take a separated child or elder home or away from the festival perimeter.
found_report.photo_label: Take or Upload Photo of Person
found_report.spoken_lang: Language They Can Speak or Understand
found_report.person_name: Name (If they are able to say it)
found_report.clothing_desc: Clothing Details (Shirt, saree, dhoti, cap, color)
found_report.offline_notice: No network connection. Report is saved locally in IndexedDB and will auto-upload the instant signal returns.
found_report.take_to_desk: Please escort the person to the designated desk below.
found_report.rule1_title: 1. Stay in a Well-Lit Public Location
found_report.rule1_desc: Stay with the lost person in a well-lit, public location on the ghat.
found_report.rule2_desc: Guide them directly to the nearest Ghat Help Desk or Police Booth.
found_report.rule3_title: 3. Never Take Away from Festival Zone
found_report.rule3_desc: Never take a separated child or elder home or away from the festival perimeter.

found_report.notes_placeholder: e.g. Speaks Hindi, was crying near water steps

matching.disclaimer: Assistive Face Match: Facial feature comparisons are calculated locally on your device. These results are hints to assist human officers and are never automatically confirmed.
matching.secondary_filters: Corroborated by Clothing & Last Seen Ghat

helpdesk.check1: 1. Guardian produced verifiable photo ID (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport)
helpdesk.check2: 2. Guardian accurately confirmed confidential family detail unknown to public
helpdesk.check3: 3. Visual confirmation of facial features, band ID, or clothing
helpdesk.check4: 4. Pilgrim visibly recognizes and feels safe with guardian
helpdesk.authorized_officers_note: Authorized for Andhra Pradesh Police & Ghat Help Desk Officers on Pushkaralu duty.
helpdesk.checklist_desc: To prevent child trafficking or mistaken identity, all 4 criteria below must be affirmatively verified by the officer before handing over the pilgrim.
helpdesk.check1_detail: Guardian produced verifiable Govt photo ID (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport).
helpdesk.check2_detail: Guardian accurately confirmed confidential family detail unknown to public.
helpdesk.check3_detail: Visual facial features, band ID, and clothing match the case profile.
helpdesk.check4_detail: Pilgrim visibly recognizes and feels safe in the care of the guardian.
helpdesk.all_4_required_error: All 4 mandatory security checks must be verified and checked.

edge_nodes.title: ESP32 Offline Edge Hotspots
edge_nodes.desc: Hardware edge nodes provide local WiFi hotspots at remote ghats when mobile internet fails. Synchronize case dumps and masked lookups via this portal.
edge_nodes.export_lookup_btn: Export Masked Lookup Table for ESP32 Nodes
edge_nodes.export_desc: Downloads a privacy-sanitized JSON lookup table (masked phone numbers only) to be loaded into remote ESP32 ghat nodes.
edge_nodes.import_desc: Uploads offline reports captured on ESP32 ghat hotspots, deduplicating records by node ID.
edge_nodes.spec_title: ESP32 Hardware Specifications & MicroPython API Contract

rituals.title: Godavari Pushkaralu 2027: Heritage & Rituals
rituals.intro_body: Pushkaralu is a sacred festival occurring once every 12 years when Jupiter (Brihaspati) enters the zodiac sign of Simha (Leo), sanctifying the holy river Godavari. The first 12 days, known as Adi Pushkaram, hold the most profound spiritual significance for millions of pilgrims.
rituals.why_matters_body: The Godavari is revered as the Dakshina Ganga. Scriptures celebrate that during Pushkaralu, the blessings and spiritual energies of all 33 crore deities and sacred rivers congregate in these waters at Rajamahendravaram.
rituals.ritual_snanam_desc: Taking a holy dip in the sacred waters with prayer, cleansing mind and spirit while invoking the blessings of ancestors and sages.
rituals.ritual_tarpanam_desc: Traditional offerings made to departed ancestors along designated ghat steps under the guidance of verified purohits.
rituals.ritual_harathi_desc: The majestic evening river aarti at Pushkar Ghat, where multi-tiered brass lamps are offered to the river accompanied by sacred Vedic chants.
rituals.ritual_deepam_desc: Devotees light earthen diyas with flowers and gently release them onto the dusk currents of the river as an offering of gratitude.
rituals.ritual_annadanam_desc: The noble tradition of distributing food, clothing, and water to pilgrims, sadhus, and devotees across every pilgrim shed.
rituals.ritual_temple_desc: Pilgrims visit the historic Kotilingeshwara, Markandeya, and Sri Uma Ramalingeswara Swamy temples gracing the riverbank.
rituals.guide_item1: Use designated bathing ghats equipped with safety barricades and life buoys.
rituals.guide_item2: Keep children and elders close. Always ensure they wear their Godavari Milan wristband.
rituals.guide_item3: Avoid carrying large sums of cash or precious jewelry into the bathing crowd.
rituals.guide_item4: Follow the directions of Ghat Marshals and volunteer assistance personnel.
rituals.verification_notice: * All cultural and ritual descriptions subject to verification with official AP Endowments Department and Temple authorities.
rituals.subtitle: Sacred Pushkaralu Heritage, Muhurtham & Worship Guide
rituals.stotram_verse: Godavari punya-jala samasta-papa-nashini | Brihaspateh praveshena pavitri-bhavati kshanat ||
rituals.stotram_meaning: The holy waters of Godavari wash away all afflictions, consecrated eternally as Jupiter enters Leo.
rituals.rituals_subheading: Understanding traditional rites observed along Rajamahendravaram bathing ghats.
rituals.rule_snanam_desc: Always bathe within safety barricades and watch for life-jacket buoys.
rituals.rule_band_title: Wristbands are Mandatory for Children & Elders
rituals.rule_band_desc: Ensure children and elderly relatives wear their Godavari Milan wristband before stepping onto ghats.
rituals.rule_valuables_desc: Avoid carrying large sums of cash or precious jewelry into the holy dip crowds.
rituals.rule_police_desc: Follow safety announcements from Ghat Marshals, NDRF personnel, and Police booths.
